tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Monday Night Football closes Week 10, and both quarterbacks are the story. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve after thumb surgery, so Jacoby Brissett — acquired from Arizona in early November — makes his first Ravens start, with Tyler Huntley also on IR. The Chargers are 0-8 and without Ladd McConkey (back), while Justin Herbert has been sacked 31 times in eight games behind a battered line. Baltimore has lost three straight and been outscored 104-33 in that stretch, but it is the healthier roster at home against a winless team. Our fair number makes Baltimore a 67.4% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Baltimore -4.5: the home favorite against a team that has not won a game, with a backup quarterback laying points as the honest caveat.
games.title: Chargers at Ravens: Brissett's first start on Monday night
games.verdict: LEAN: BAL -4.5 — no true edge; the healthier home roster against a winless team, with a backup QB laying points as the caveat.
games.weather: Clear and 48F at kickoff, light NW wind; no NWS watch or warning.

games.our_fair: Timberwolves 54.4% / Trail Blazers 45.6% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: This one carries the board's only edge: Toumani Camara Over 11.5 Points at -110 is +2.3% EV against devigged FanDuel. Camara has cleared 11.5 in 4 of his last 5, averaging 12.1 points over his last 10 while starting and playing 30-38 minutes. Portland is 9-3 and 6-1 on the road, visiting a Minnesota side without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) and Jaylen Clark (hamstring). The Blazers are without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe themselves, so both backcourts are thin. Our fair number makes Minnesota a 54.4% favorite, and no side price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge on the side, but the lean is Portland +2.5: the hotter road team against a depleted Minnesota backcourt.
games.title: Trail Blazers at Timberwolves: the board's only edge lives here
games.verdict: LEAN: POR +2.5 — no true edge on the side; the 9-3 road team against a Minnesota side missing its three best guards. (Board play: Camara Over 11.5 Points -110, +2.3% EV.)

games.take: The near-miss that did not make the board: Pelle Larsson Over 2.5 Assists at -155 was +1.1% EV against devigged FanDuel, but Larsson is questionable with an illness and has missed Miami's last two games — a prop on a player who may not play is not a play, so it was cut. Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back without Clint Capela (ankle) and Fred VanVleet (knee), and Marcus Smart is suspended. Miami is 7-6 at home with Giannis Antetokounmpo available and Klay Thompson cleared. Our fair number makes Houston a 56.8% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Miami +2.5: the home dog with its stars available against a short-handed Rockets side on a back-to-back.
games.title: Rockets at Heat: the cut prop and the home dog
games.verdict: LEAN: MIA +2.5 — no true edge; the home dog against a short-handed Rockets side on the second night of a back-to-back.

games.take: The biggest favorite on the NBA slate: Boston lays 8.5 at home against an Orlando side without Paolo Banchero and Jonathan Isaac. The Magic are short-handed on the road against a Celtics team priced as a 75.1% favorite on our fair number, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Boston -8.5: the healthy home favorite against a depleted visitor.
games.title: Magic at Celtics: the short-handed visitor
games.verdict: LEAN: BOS -8.5 — no true edge; the healthy home favorite against a depleted Magic side.

games.take: The highest total on the slate at 241.5, and a Cleveland side still without Evan Mobley (illness), though Donovan Mitchell is expected back and James Harden and Jarrett Allen are off the injury report. Chicago visits as a 9.5-point dog. Our fair number makes Cleveland a 75.8% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Cleveland -9.5: the home favorite with Mitchell back, Mobley out as the honest caveat.
games.title: Bulls at Cavaliers: the biggest total on the board
games.verdict: LEAN: CLE -9.5 — no true edge; the home favorite with Mitchell back, Mobley out as the caveat.

games.matchup: Golden State Warriors @ New Orleans Pelicans
games.take: Stephen Curry is OUT with an illness, and Golden State is still laying 3.5 on the road in New Orleans. The market is saying the Warriors' depth covers for Curry; the Pelicans get a home dog spot against a Curry-less favorite. Our fair number makes Golden State a 60.8% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is New Orleans +3.5: the home dog catching a favorite without its engine.
games.title: Warriors at Pelicans: Curry is out, the line barely moved
games.venue: Smoothie King Center, New Orleans, LA
games.verdict: LEAN: NOP +3.5 — no true edge; the home dog against a Curry-less favorite.

games.take: Phoenix was a +143 home dog on the board yesterday and lost 131-123 to the Lakers; now the Suns are 9.5-point road dogs in Denver on the second night of a back-to-back. Denver is priced as a 78.6% favorite on our fair number, the heaviest on the slate. No price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Denver -9.5: the rested heavy home favorite against a Suns side playing its second game in two nights.
games.title: Suns at Nuggets: the heaviest favorite on the slate
games.verdict: LEAN: DEN -9.5 — no true edge; the rested heavy home favorite against a Suns side on a back-to-back.

games.take: Philadelphia lays 5.5 on the road in Brooklyn, priced as a 67.1% favorite on our fair number. The 76ers are the better team in this matchup and the market has them as a clear road favorite. No price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Philadelphia -5.5: the better team laying less than six on the road.
games.title: 76ers at Nets: the road favorite
games.verdict: LEAN: PHI -5.5 — no true edge; the better team laying less than six on the road.
